IC2: Objectively confirmed diagnosis of acute PE [AND] by multidetector CT angiography [OR], ventilation/perfusion lung scan [OR], or selective invasive pulmonary angiography, according to established diagnostic criteria, with or without symptomatic deep vein thrombosis
IC3: [NOT] Absence of hemodynamic collapse [OR], or decompensation, at presentation; Hemodynamic collapse or decompensation
